verdict.rationale: OCI's general IAM system supports policy-based, least-privilege access control and token-based authentication without static keypairs (oracle-cloud-docs-22, oracle-cloud-docs-17, oracle-cloud-docs-9), which could in principle be used to scope credentials for an automated agent. However, there is no documentation specifically addressing issuing scoped credentials for an AI agent or non-human/service-account workload identity. Missing for 10: explicit agent/service-account credential scoping mechanism (e.g. dynamic groups/instance principals), documentation tying IAM policies to AI-agent use cases, and any hands-on/community confirmation of this workflow.
